The world's #1 tandem paragliding destination. Fly from Babadağ Mountain (1,960m) over the legendary Blue Lagoon in Ölüdeniz, Fethiye. Over 100,000 flights completed safely every year.

Why Is Ölüdeniz the World's Best Paragliding Destination?

Ölüdeniz paragliding is consistently ranked as the #1 tandem paragliding experience on Earth. The combination of Babadağ Mountain's dramatic 1,960-meter altitude, the thermal winds rising from the Lycian Coast, and the breathtaking landing zone on Belcekiz Beach overlooking the turquoise Blue Lagoon creates a flight experience that no other location can match.

Every year, over 100,000 tandem flights launch from Babadağ — more than any other paragliding site globally. The Turkish Aeronautical Association (THK) regulates all commercial operations, ensuring that every pilot holds a THK T2 tandem license with 500+ solo flight hours. This level of regulation is what makes paragliding in Ölüdeniz not just spectacular, but exceptionally safe.

What Makes the Ölüdeniz Flight Unique

🏔️ 1,960m Launch Altitude

Babadağ Mountain is one of the highest commercial paragliding launches in the world. The altitude means longer flights (25-45 minutes), stronger thermals, and a panoramic view stretching from Fethiye to the Greek island of Rhodes.

🌊 Blue Lagoon Landing

You land directly on Belcekiz Beach, steps from the famous Ölüdeniz Blue Lagoon. No other paragliding site in the world offers a beach landing over such an iconic landscape. Your flight ends where your holiday begins.

☀️ 280+ Flying Days/Year

The Ölüdeniz microclimate provides reliable thermal conditions from April through November, with the strongest thermals in July–August. Even winter flights are possible on calm days, making it a year-round paragliding destination.

Your Ölüdeniz Paragliding Experience Step-by-Step

  1. Hotel Pickup (08:00 or 14:00): Our air-conditioned minibus collects you from your hotel in Fethiye, Ölüdeniz, Hisarönü, or Çalış Beach.
  2. Drive to Babadağ (40 min): The scenic mountain road climbs through pine forests with panoramic views of the Lycian Coast. The cable car takes you to the launch zone.
  3. Safety Briefing (10 min): Your pilot explains the takeoff procedure — just 3-5 running steps. You'll be fitted with a certified harness and reserve parachute.
  4. Takeoff from 1,960m: You run a few steps, the wing fills, and suddenly Ölüdeniz unfolds beneath you — the Blue Lagoon, Butterfly Valley, and the endless Mediterranean.
  5. Flight (25-45 min): Your pilot catches thermals over the mountain ridges. Eagles fly beside you. The silence is broken only by wind. Optional acrobatics available over the sea.
  6. Beach Landing: A gentle touchdown on Belcekiz Beach. If you booked the 4K Media Bundle, your video and photos are transferred to your phone instantly.

Frequently Asked About Ölüdeniz Paragliding

Have questions about weight limits, what to wear, or weather cancellations? Our complete FAQ with 15+ expert answers covers everything. Some quick facts:

  • Weight limit: 100kg men / 85kg women
  • Age: 6+ with parental consent
  • Experience needed: None — the pilot does everything
  • Season: April–November (best: July–October)
  • Weather cancel: Full refund or free reschedule
